title: The regulars
logline: Wednesday. The tavern's regulars, seen from the garage: through the shared wall, as shapes and sounds. Wood draws them without seeing them. Gully names them; the strip doesn't.

panels.composition: The garage, evening. Through the wall, drawn as shapes in the plaster: four REGULARS at a bar, glasses, a jukebox. WOOD drawing them. GULLY visiting. BARNABY.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a garage at evening where four figures at a bar are drawn as shapes inside the shared plaster wall, a man drawing them, another man in an apron visiting, a dog

panels.composition: The pad: four figures at a bar, from behind, drawn from sound. One with a hat. One who laughs on the beat.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, close-up of a drawing pad showing four figures at a bar from behind, one in a hat

panels.composition: Gully looking at the pad. Knowing them.

balloons.text: That's Dale. That's — the hat's Dale.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a man in an apron recognizing figures on a pad while the thin man who drew them refuses the names

panels.composition: The wall. The jukebox shape. Nine o'clock: the Springsteen. Wood and Gully and the dog, listening to the wall.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, two men and a dog in a garage listening to a wall where a jukebox is drawn as a shape in the plaster, no words
image.notes: The regulars' names: reserved; Gully knows them, the strip doesn't.

art.palette: limited; Sundays in watercolor, good now
art.paper: bristol; the browser; from 2008 coastal newsprint a week behind

notes: 'I drew a hat.' The regulars as shapes.
